home.kicker: An interactive course on how a business runs
home.title: Watch goods and cash move, then make a supplier late.
home.intro: Each lesson follows products from a supplier to a warehouse, a shop and a customer, and the money flowing back. Then a supplier is late, demand jumps or customers pay late, and you watch the shelves and the bank balance.
notice: For learning only. Simplified example business with round numbers.
